APPROVE
The extraction keeps the same short-circuit order and per-line outcomes (the DEPENDENCIES `continue` was the last statement in the loop, so returning null and skipping is equivalent), the `||`/`is not { } entry` form is definitely assigned and compiles, and by my count the method drops from 25 to about 13. I couldn't build this, since the repository isn't on this machine, so the build condition rests on the diff alone, assuming `resolved` is declared as a `Dictionary<string, string>`.
